name: Corvus
bio: Archetype: Dynamo, ST DPT, Extra Action. ⌽ Deploys [Pulsing Field] at turn start if it isn't already active. Gains [Dynamo] for every actively-cast skill. ⌽ Skill 2 inflicts [Welding] on a single enemy and makes self enter [Stitching]. The enemy with [Welding] will generate [Electric Arc] for Corvus on hit; more on Mental DMG hit. ⌽ Skills inflict [Breaking Point] on enemies. At turn end, uses an Extra Action to attack the enemy with [Welding], dealing more damage based on [Pulsing Field] level, and consumes [Breaking Point] to deal even more damage based on [Electric Arc] and [Flickering Arc] stacks. Then, injects [Dynamo] into [Pulsing Field]. ⌽ Ultimate deals damage and procs one additional Extra Action. ⌽ Under Lv. 3 [Pulsing Field], has +5 Moxie limit and gains 3 Moxie. On expiry, converts [Electric Arc] into [Flickering Arc] and [Dynamo].
